branchOps.rationale: branch deletion and force operations can discard unreviewed history

credentialUse.rationale: credential use can exfiltrate or misuse secrets beyond the task's scope

dependencyInstall.rationale: installing dependencies executes third-party code inside the project

destructiveShell.rationale: destructive shell commands can irreversibly delete work or system state

externalNetwork.rationale: external network access can leak repository content or fetch untrusted code

merge.rationale: merging lands changes on shared branches other collaborators build on

prCreation.rationale: opening a PR publishes work product and triggers CI under the human's identity

examples: editing prod config or feature flags
productionAffecting.rationale: production-affecting changes have blast radius beyond the repository
